policies.name: Active members read embeddings
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM subscriptions s
  WHERE ((s.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (s.status = ANY (ARRAY['trialing'::text, 'active'::text, 'past_due'::text])))))
